rationale: The short thesis remains intact: price is still below the 5m 9-EMA ($16.35) and broad risk-off conditions with high relative volume favor downside continuation. Price is hovering just above session VWAP ($16.04) and the take-profit ($16.02); a clean break of VWAP would likely trigger the target, while the invalidation at $16.55 allows normal noise. The recent high-volume 1m candle shows some support but has not reclaimed the 9-EMA or invalidated the setup.
